219060.preText: All fielders in, 1 run required of 1 ball.
219060.text: and they get the single for a wonderful win, in the block-hole and squeezed out to the onside, the fielder rushes in and throws at the bowlers end, the batter crosses over for the win.
219060.postText: A thriller! Poiyamozhi does it in style with only 2 deliveries left and 7 runs required, steps in to hit a six and then pick up a single. Wonderful knock from Ajitesh 112 from 60 balls, who did the most in the run chase. Nellai Royal Kings win by 4 wickets. Hari: "This is why TNPL is the best State T20 league in India!" Thanks for tuning in, do join us for more TNPL after a break on Saturday. A double-header on Sunday. That is it from Sudeep and this is Binoy George signing off.
